currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated southwest view: buff brick church with a large pointed/bulging dome on short drum,eastern dome/western roof belfry,flat parapeted body with tall pointed blind niches/selected small windows. Roof belfry has four pointed openings,blue geometric tile edges and a smaller round-column lantern/cone. Freestanding western belfry has four large pointed lower arches,pale columns/balustrade,smaller upper open column stage and a brick cone/cross. Surrounding flat/vaulted low roofs are simplified. Exact sculpture,lettering/tile patterns and interior excluded.

Inspected western entrance: brick boundary with blind niches,stone-columned open gateway and blue lunette panel. A slender square clock tower rises above it with two arched relief panels,round clock,small open upper stage and a blue/white pyramid roof/finial. Church dome and both conical belfries behind resolve west-to-east order. Forecourt statue/fountain/trees excluded.

Inspected library facade: warm brick rectangular pavilion with central round-headed wood door,two flanking arched windows,selected upper rosettes/star,blue inscription band,cross and triangular pediment/balustrade with two pale corner columns. Its correspondence to the northwest mapped pavilion is an approximation;museum/range functions and remaining facades are not independently verified.
